## [1.6.0](https://github.com/Dyno0311/dyno-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-11-17)

### ✨ New Features

* spoof app signature via PackageInfo hook extension ([e672ead](https://github.com/Dyno0311/dyno-patches/commit/e672ead1d8fb1fcd9e6b031a40601a6918e1622f))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* add extension manifest ([71aa3c9](https://github.com/Dyno0311/dyno-patches/commit/71aa3c9655ba26ceeb30eeab8c318da9c5385746))

patches.name: Hide piracy warning
patches.description: Removes the "This CamScanner copy is not genuine" dialog and toast. The app's internal genuine/pirate state is left alone, so nothing re-routes features.

patches.name: Remove PDF watermark
patches.description: Stops the Scanned with CamScanner watermark from being drawn into exported and shared PDFs. The local document is otherwise produced by the same native PDF engine, unmodified.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Blocks every CamScanner ad position at the interceptor choke point (app launch, main/share/page banners, doc list, scan-done and rewarded inventory). Ad SDKs stay bundled but receive no requests.

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description: Reports the original signing certificate to the app so tamper and licence checks pass.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Reports a local VIP / super-VIP account status and sync entitlement, unlocking the features CamScanner gates behind its subscription check on device. Cloud credits, Word/Excel conversion and other server-side work stay validated remotely.
